preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case consists of exactly two lines: the first line is n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), and the second line contains n integers a_1, ..., a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(n) <= 10**5 for n in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a_i) <= int(n) for n, a_line in zip([line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]) for a_i in a_line)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each tag a_i is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(int(n) for n in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line in ['-1'] or (int(stdout_line) >= 0 and int(stdout_line) <= n - 1) for stdout_line, n in zip([line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (no valid permutation exists) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum possible cost of a valid permutation (0 ≤ cost ≤ n - 1).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line == '-1') == (not any(all(a[p[i]] != a[p[i+1]] for i in range(n-1)) for p in permutations(range(1, n+1)))) for stdout_line, n, a_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
postconditions.description: If no permutation exists where no two consecutive problems have the same tag, the output is -1. Otherwise, the output is the minimum cost over all valid permutations.

postconditions.expression: all((int(stdout_line) == min(sum(1 for i in range(n-1) if abs(p[i+1] - p[i]) > 1) for p in permutations(range(1, n+1)) if all(a[p[i]] != a[p[i+1]] for i in range(n-1)))) if stdout_line != '-1' else True for stdout_line, n, a_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum cost (number of non-adjacent consecutive pairs) among all valid permutations where no two consecutive problems have the same tag. The cost is defined as the count of indices i (1 ≤ i < n) where |p_{i+1} - p_i| > 1.
